test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 21 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

This small hut is going to be my _____ for the next three days.
solution:
The correct answer is __**abode**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The meaning of word abode is** a place to live.**
 
• **Example** - Can I **abode **at your place today?
 
• The meaning of the above sentence is** "The small hut will be my place to live for the next three days".**<
